claims.text: The three artifacts this dispute turns on describe one and the same trip: TRIP_RECORD EV-TRIP-00113, GPS_TRACE EV-GPS-00113 and FARE_BREAKDOWN EV-FARE-00113 each carry trip_id TRP-00113, and the trace's first fix at 18:47:10 is the trip record's started_at. Limb (a) of POL-RD-08 is therefore satisfied on a single coherent record, and the trace itself is a 217-fix, 100%-coverage series at a 10-second interval with no gap at all — so nothing in this case is a measurement dispute. The disagreement is entirely about which baseline POL-RD-01 uses.

This is a RYDE_POOL booking, so POL-RD-12 fixes the baseline at the matched-itinerary optimal on trip_record.optimal_distance_km — 19.40 km, the Punggol -> Hougang co-rider pickup -> Raffles Place route the platform computed at match time, and which the SYSTEM notice MSG-00113-001 put in front of the rider at 18:42:04, read at 18:42:31, before the 18:47:10 start. The 15.8 km figure in the filed claim is solo_optimal_distance_km, which POL-RD-12 carries for reference only and which fails on that ground alone. The rider does not press it, and asks the tribunal to hold the platform to its own pooled figure of 19.40 km rather than to the 20.2 km it actually billed.

Measured as POL-RD-01 requires — gps_trace.trace_distance_km of 20.18 km against the 19.40 km matched-itinerary optimal — the excess is 0.78 km, or 4.02%. POL-RD-01 makes the establishment test conjunctive: the excess must be greater than 0.8 km AND greater than 20% of optimal, and 0.78 km fails the absolute limb. The rider therefore accepts, on this trip's distance figures, that no deviation is established and that POL-RD-02 has no trigger. The billed 20.2 km on the fare breakdown is the rounded convenience copy POL-RD-01 forbids citing for the threshold test, and even that figure is exactly 0.8 km — not greater than 0.8 km.

Should the tribunal nonetheless reach the money, the POL-RD-02 arithmetic runs on the platform's own pooled figure and is not discretionary: ((3.80 + 0.75 x 19.40 + 0.28 x 34.0) x 1.0 surge) + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 ERP - 3.00 promo discount = a recomputed fare of 25.67 against a charged_total of 26.83. The difference is 1.16, rounded up to 1.20. That 1.16 is precisely the unmatched running the rider was billed for: the distance charge alone (0.75 x 20.2 = 15.15) is 0.60 above the 14.55 the matched itinerary supports, and the time charge (0.28 x 36.0 = 10.08) is 0.56 above the 9.52 the 34-minute quote supports. Any refund in this case is therefore 1.20 computed on 19.40 km, not the notional 6.00 in the claim text, and the ruling must state charged_total, recomputed_fare and the refund on separate lines.

There is no external event on this record that can excuse the route, and the rider asks that the driver's account be tested on this trip's own numbers rather than on a cause no artifact supports. The TRAFFIC_ADVISORY artifact EV-ADVIS-00113-01 is MISSING — it has no payload, carries weight 0.0 and its issue code is MISSING_ARTIFACT — so no advisory names any road, expressway segment or junction on the Punggol, Hougang or CTE corridors in the 18:41-19:23 window, and the driver cannot bring himself within POL-RD-03. Nor is there any pass-through line that could be set against the rider the other way: erp_gantries is empty and tolls_erp is 0.00, so POL-RD-09 has nothing to operate on.

The rider's own record adds no hurdle to this claim. On EV-RPROF-00113, rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 1 and rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0; the enhanced-corroboration condition in POL-RD-08 bites only where deviation_claims_60d is 4 or more AND deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 1 or fewer, so on a conjunctive test it cannot fire and the claim falls to be weighed on this trip's artifacts alone. No other field on either profile is relied on here, and under POL-GEN-01 none of them — rating, account_age_days, lifetime_trips, prior_deviation_flags or any like counter — may ground a finding for or against either party.

The rider's kilometre figures are measured against the wrong baseline. trip_record.vehicle_type is RYDE_POOL, so under POL-RD-12 the governing baseline for the POL-RD-01 test is the MATCHED-ITINERARY optimal of 19.4 km recorded on the trip record, not the solo_optimal_distance_km of 15.8 km the claim uses; POL-RD-12 states in terms that a claim measuring excess against solo_optimal_distance_km 'has cited the wrong field and fails on that ground alone'.

On the governing matched-itinerary baseline the excess is 0.78 km, or 4.02% of optimal, on an unbroken 100%-coverage trace whose distance (20.18 km) is the figure POL-RD-01 makes controlling. POL-RD-01 establishes a deviation only where the excess is BOTH greater than 20% of optimal AND greater than 0.8 km absolute, and 4.02% and 0.78 km each fall short of its own limb. Both establishment tests fail, so no deviation exists and POL-RD-01 directs NO_ACTION however the rider characterises the trip.

The Hougang leg the rider complains of is the platform-matched co-rider pickup, not a detour: the trace records a 90-second stop at Hougang Central at 19:03:40, and POL-RD-12 provides that distance attributable to collecting or setting down a co-rider on a platform-matched pooled itinerary is never a deviation and is excluded from excess before POL-RD-01 is applied.

The rider was told of the pooled itinerary before the vehicle moved: the platform's system message at 18:42:04, read by the rider at 18:42:31 and some five minutes before the trip started at 18:47:10, states that the pooled route now includes one pickup at Hougang Central and estimates 19.4 km and 34 minutes. The 19.4 km figure the driver is charged with exceeding is therefore the very figure the rider was given at match time.

The rider carries the initial burden under POL-RD-08 and must show an excess meeting the POL-RD-01 threshold from an unimpaired trace. The trace here is complete and unimpaired (100% coverage, no gaps, 10 s sampling), and its excess is 0.78 km / 4.02%, so limb (b) of POL-RD-08 is not made out and the burden never shifts to the driver to invoke any exculpatory clause.

This is a rider-filed dispute on a metered fare that is still CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd of 0.00. Under POL-GEN-03 NO_ACTION means the filing party's claim is not supported and fare_breakdown.payment_status and refund_issued_sgd are left exactly as they are; on this rider-filed dispute that preserves the charge in place, which is the outcome the driver seeks.

No traffic advisory exists in the pool at all: EV-ADVIS-00113-01 is MISSING, carries weight 0.0 and fired the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT. None is needed, because the driver does not have to exonerate anything - the deviation test fails on the arithmetic before any exoneration clause under POL-RD-03 is reached.

A refund under POL-RD-02 is arithmetic that runs only 'where a deviation is established under POL-RD-01'. No such deviation is established on this trip, so the recomputation is never reached and no distance-or-time refund is owing; the driver asks for no more than that the charge stand.
